thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — release train for Tue 09:00 PST. Focus: routing perf + model swap. Plan is staggered canaries per region, then prod if green. Who can own which canary? :rocket:
ken: I can take us-west1 canary. Will start at 09:05 PST and post status here.
devin: I can pick eu-west1 but need a 10m pre-window for the migration flag and cache prewarm. Prefer 09:15.
sam: Reminder: feature flag `new-routing` must be enabled only on canaries. I'll flip after smoke passes and hold the prod flip until we confirm metrics.
ops-bot: Reminder — run smoke sequence after deploy: `./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --quick` and `curl -f http://internal-smoke/health` :white_check_mark:
maria: Short smoke checklist for canary (do quickly, post pass/fail):
```
- api health (200 OK)
- p50/p95 latency under thresholds
- 5 synthetic requests through new-routing path
- no errors in model-serving logs
- db replica lag < 5s
```
ken: noted. Will share logs link once canary starts. I'll keep a deploy slot message when I click go. :eyes:
devin: Migration specifics — running `migrations/partial_backfill.js` requires a short exclusive window. I'll run it during eu canary (09:15) and monitor. If it blocks >3m, abort and rollback.
nina: Oncall (sre) will monitor error budget and latency. If error rate >1% for 2 consecutive mins or p95 degrades >200ms, rollback plan is to revert flag + route traffic back to model-v1. I'll be watching.
sam: Stagger windows by 5m to reduce cold-start impact across regions? So us-west1 09:05, us-east1 09:10, eu-west1 09:15. If any canary fails, stop next windows.
maria: Agreed. Prod window tentatively 09:40-10:00 if all canaries green by 09:30. Prod deploy steps: quick smoke, feature-flag flip, monitor 15m, then full traffic.
ux: Will run a quick UX sanity swipe post-canary once sam toggles flag. Aim to respond within 10m.
deploy-bot: FYI — I'll create a deploy thread per region when each slot starts. Links will be posted here.
ken: us-west1 canary started at 09:05 PST. logs: https://deploys.internal/1845678901/us-west1 :thumbsup:
ops-bot: smoke result (us-west1): PASS — 5/5 synthetic checks ok, p95 180ms.
devin: eu-west1 canary started at 09:15 PST. Running migration now, monitoring.
ken: us-east1 slot is next at 09:10 but holding until we get ops confirmation from nina.
nina: ops good to go for us-east1 at 09:10. I'll watch error spikes.
sam: flipped `new-routing` for us-west1 after smoke. UX confirmed no regressions.
maria: All right — if eu-backfill completes cleanly and eu smoke is green, we open prod at 09:40. If anything odd, fallback = revert flag + rollback commit ID <abc123>.
devin: backfill finished cleanly at 09:22, smoke PASS for eu-west1.
ops-bot: us-east1 smoke (09:12) PASS.
sre_team: Monitoring window started for prod readiness. Have rollback steps listed: `revert-flag -> redeploy-stable` and alert paging list.
maria: Thanks team. I'll post a brief release note and update the release calendar. If anyone spots anything odd in next 30m, call it out here and we pause. :hand:
deploy-bot: PROD window opened at 09:40 PST — starting rollout to 20% traffic. Will increment at 5m intervals pending green metrics.
ken: Observability looks clean at 09:45 — no error spikes.
nina: Keep an eye on model latencies, especially tail latencies for big prompts.
sam: toggled prod flag at 09:50 after green checks.
maria: Closing loop — prod at 100% by 09:55, monitoring for 15m. Great job, everyone. :tada:
